title: Security operative licence
summary: This page provides information about the security operative licence required to work in the security industry in New South Wales.
who_can_apply: You must be working in the security industry in New South Wales.
what_you_need: The page does not list specific documents or requirements for obtaining the licence.

faqs.q: What is a security operative licence?
faqs.a: A security operative licence is required if you plan to work in the security industry in New South Wales.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a security operative licence?
faqs.a: You can apply for a security operative licence using the dedicated application page.

faqs.q: What if I need to renew or replace my licence?
faqs.a: You can renew your licence or replace it using the specific online services.
